description: Data residency policy for Lafiya. Lists every processor that stores or processes Lafiya data, the approved regions per environment, and the legal basis for any cross-border transfer under the Nigeria Data Protection Act (NDPA).

processors.name: Supabase
processors.purpose: Primary database, authentication, and file storage for Lafiya health data.
processors.legalBasis: NDPA s.41 cross-border transfer with adequacy/contractual safeguards; data stored in-region.

processors.name: Vercel
processors.purpose: Application hosting and edge runtime for the Lafiya web app.
processors.legalBasis: NDPA s.41 processor contract; no persistent health data stored at the edge.

processors.name: Sentry
processors.purpose: Error and performance monitoring. PHI must be scrubbed before transmission.
processors.legalBasis: NDPA s.41 processor contract; PHI scrubbing enforced in the Sentry SDK before send.

processors.name: Transactional email provider
processors.purpose: Delivery of transactional email such as appointment reminders and account notices.
processors.legalBasis: NDPA s.41 processor contract; message content limited to non-clinical notifications.

processors.name: Transactional SMS provider
processors.purpose: Delivery of transactional SMS such as appointment reminders and one-time codes.
processors.legalBasis: NDPA s.41 processor contract; message content limited to non-clinical notifications.
